# Aalm Vastralay (आलम वस्त्रालय) — Marketplace Platform
> Open-Source Indian Ethnic Wear & Multi-Vendor Bridal Couture Marketplace Template.

## Store Information
- Platform: Aalm Vastralay Multi-Vendor E-Commerce Template
- Location: Bihar, India
- Contact / WhatsApp: Configurable via NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPPORT_PHONE
- Official Email: Configurable via NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPPORT_EMAIL
- Supported Currency: INR (₹)
- Payment Methods: Dynamic UPI QR (0% gateway fee), Cash on Delivery (COD), Online Netbanking/Cards.

## Product Categories
- Royal Bridal Lehengas & Velvet Cholis
- Handcrafted Banarasi & Kanjeevaram Silk Sarees
- Designer Sherwanis & Indo-Western Groom Wear
- Wedding Kurta Pajama Sets
- Pure Chiffon, Georgette & Organza Dupattas
- Festive & Traditional Jewellery

## Shipping & Serviceability
- Pan-India Delivery across all 28 states and union territories.
- Express delivery (2-3 business days) to North, Central, and Western circles.
- Free shipping on orders above ₹999.
- 7-Day Easy Exchange / Return Window.
